reviews.title: Pay wall held my scan for ransom
reviews.text:
I haven’t used the app since August. Today (October) I picked it up and scanned 13 pages of a document. When I tapped to move on to check and save the document I got stuck on a page demanding I subscribe with a free trial. I already own this app and have been happily using it for many years. 

I tried to restore my purchase which the app told me was successful. But would not let me get to my document without subscribing. I was stuck with 13 scanned pages and unable to get anything out of it. 

So I subscribed with a free trial. And immediately cancelled my subscription. 

I don’t know what happened. Did Readdle remove my ownership of the app for a new pricing model? Or did I have some kind of glitch? Very bad experience to have in the middle of working on a document. 

I hope after my “free trial” ends the app will revert back so I can continue using it.

reviews.title: Recent update has broken it

I’ve restarted the app and restarted my phone to no avail. The app is now completely unusable.

reviews.title: What happened to this app?
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this Scanner Pro app for many years and have found it to be amazing up until the most recent update. The changes made it take longer for me to rename a file after creating it, because I’m not paying for their AI service to automatically name it for me. 

But the worst part is that it is freezing like crazy and taking forever to actually scan files after I open the app. which has me here writing this review and thinking of needing to find a new scanning app. 

All of the recent changes seem to have made the app worse, while also adding AI and pushing me towards an unwanted subscription. 

I’m using it on a brand new iPhone 18 Pro Max with iOS 27 and I have the newest version available of Scanner Pro as of 10/6/26.

reviews.title: Going downhill for legacy users
reviews.text:
The app used to be great - I have been a user for 5+ years but it has started to fall off since they rolled out the premium versions.  I mainly use it for quick scans when I am away from my computer, but the last several times the app crashes when I try to add a scans.  I’ve tried the old IT trick of deleting and reinstalling and still have issues. 

For something I use occasionally, I am not willing to pay $7.99/week just to be able to do a basic scan.

reviews.title: icloud sync is on by default!?
reviews.text: I can’t believe that this thing was syncing my stuff on iCloud by default when I didn’t even realize it.. I’ve been using this app for years and years. I decided to try it on my iPad separately from my iPhone. I decided to do two test scans on my ipad for fun. I then deleted the scanner from my iPad since I mainly use it on my iPhone.. when I got a new iPhone and I re-downloaded scanner Pro.. I saw those two same test scans from my iPad from months ago popped up on my new iPhone, freshly downloaded scanner Pro app.. ummm that’s SCARY. i don’t want my scans going to the cloud!! I can’t believe that was on by default.. and there doesn’t seem to be a way you can delete whatever was backed up in the cloud

reviews.title: App has went way down hill
reviews.text: I have used this app for at least 8yrs. It used to be the best on the market. I purchased it for $1.99 that’s how long ago it’s been. But now, they keep trying to add more and more and more. There are no new buttons so what used to be 1 touch with the phone is now 3-5 to get to where you want to be. Just naming a doc is a whole process now. When before it was click and type. If I had options to delete 99% of the options they keep trying to add it be great again. It is the best B/W copies. I scan deeds from the 1800’s forward all day every day and have switched over to the hated adobe….. that’s how bad it has gotten. Now, it still has the best scans with an iPhone 17. But for some reason do not translate from phone quality to pdf quality. Half the time I have to go back to my phone to read some docs. Less is more, speed is what we want and need. And we will not be charged weekly, monthly, yearly…. Get you act together

reviews.title: Was the Best, but Now - junk!
reviews.text:
I thought they couldn’t make it worse… I was wrong!  The “cool” teenage coders decided to change the background from black to an unbelievably bright blue which makes it extremely difficult to see what you  the actual scans.  It is like looking into a flashlight.  Way to go backwards Scanner Pro!  Does anyone there ever test your product usability? Just asking? Go back to the dark background and quit trying to add junk for the sake of just adding junk.

Money grubbing, developers!  This used to be the very best scanning app available and I purchased it years ago.  However, as the years have passed Readdle keeps adding junk that is useless with popups galore to add “features” to subscribe to this junk that, unless you subscribe at a ridiculous price, has rendered this app useless.  Their marketing has killed it!  
Most customers are sick of ridiculous subscriptions that just aren’t worth the price!  This app falls into that category now.  All I want is a good scanner!  I don’t want a relationship ceremony that keeps getting more expensive, with a useless promise of just getting uglier in the future!  That is apparently what this developer intends for its customers.  I’m ready for the divorce now!
